description:
A real estate investment analyst needs to identify the most expensive neighborhoods in New York City. Using the provided dataset `nyc_sales_2019.csv` (C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\PowerBITasks\nyc_sales_2019.csv), build a Power BI report named `NYC_Market_Analysis.pbix` on the Desktop.

Your tasks:
1. Import the data.
2. Create a calculated column `Price_Per_SqFt` = `SALE PRICE` / `GROSS SQUARE FEET`.
3. Create a measure `Median_PPSF` = MEDIAN of `Price_Per_SqFt`.
4. Filter the Report Page to exclude rows where `SALE PRICE` < 10,000 OR `GROSS SQUARE FEET` < 1 (remove invalid data).
5. Create a Clustered Bar Chart showing the Top 10 Neighborhoods by `Median_PPSF`.
6. Create a Line Chart showing `Median_PPSF` trend over time (Sale Date).
7. Save the file to C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\NYC_Market_Analysis.pbix.
